rationale: The bid-ask spread of 194 bps is prohibitively wide for intraday trading, creating an immediate structural disadvantage that requires a large move just to break even. While relative volume is elevated at 11x and price is holding above VWAP with bullish momentum, the lack of any news catalyst explaining the volume spike introduces significant uncertainty about direction and sustainability. The wide spread combined with unclear catalyst makes the risk/reward unfavorable in either direction.
